scope: Map eviction and native-kfunc security design audit; no runtime validation claim

threads.reason: Authoritative current-state binding; failure must remain observable and unknown. Task birth and capture epoch now validate lookup.

shadows.reason: Paired return history. Independent eviction could restore inconsistent state; retained exact with invalidation and depth diagnostics.

warm_tmp.reason: Map-owned scratch is passed through sleepable capture. Eviction and recreation need a lifetime/ownership proof before conversion.

fused_opener.reason: Operation-entry snapshot, not a recomputable cache. Endpoint snapshots now carry capture epoch and are rejected across transitions.

fused_lineval.reason: Sleepable per-thread scratch ownership must remain coherent with warm_tmp.

slots.reason: Descriptor identity and generation state; exhaustion increments state_errors, history gaps remain explicit.

origins.reason: Frozen opener provenance; exhaustion increments state_errors, no silent eviction.

eviction_metrics: Lookup absence counts as binding_unavailable, not an eviction count. No implicit LRU eviction is claimed measurable.

native_kfunc_admission.remaining_exposure: While loaded, tracing kfuncs remain available to other authorized tracing BPF loaders.
rejected_mechanisms: Reproducible program tag as ownership proof
requirements: Define trust boundary between loader security domains
Use kernel-enforced loader admission, such as supported LSM policy, with deployment-specific adversary testing
Verify APIs and load-time ordering on every supported kernel
Keep test-only registrations opt-in; retain module-free fleet default
native_kfunc_admission.claim: Existing program-type filtering and gated test registrations are not object ownership authentication.

performance_limits: Identity-only collection retains global hook and attached-probe dispatch costs
Runtime statistics incur global instrumentation while the scoped handle is open
BPF runtime counters omit some dispatch/application and userspace costs
No lossless or production performance claim is made
